caption:
🔥 गनमास्टर जी9 से आया प्यार का मौसम, इमरान-जेनेलिया की जोड़ी ने मचाया धमाल! 💖

फिल्म Gunmaaster G9 का नया रोमांटिक गाना 'Dard E Dil' रिलीज हो गया है, जिसमें Emraan Hashmi और Genelia Deshmukh नजर आ रहे हैं। 🎶

इस गाने को Himesh Reshammiya और Akasa Singh ने गाया और कंपोज किया है, जबकि इसके बोल Sonia Kapoor Reshammiya ने लिखे हैं। ✨

Himesh Reshammiya का कहना है कि उनके पिछले गाने ‘Afsaana Banaaya Aapne’ और ‘Do Do Din Ki Zindagi’ को अलग-अलग प्लेटफॉर्म्स पर 300 मिलियन से ज्यादा व्यूज मिले हैं। 📈

Director Aditya Datt का कहना है कि इस गाने का मुखड़ा और हुक लाइन उनके दादा आनंद बख्शी जी के कर्ज फिल्म के गाने 'Dard-E-Dil Dard-E-Jigar' की याद दिलाते हैं। 🎬

Producer Deepak Mukut का कहना है कि यह गाना फिल्म को एक खूबसूरत रोमांटिक डायमेंशन देता है और इमरान-जेनेलिया की जोड़ी को म्यूजिकल हाई देता है। 🌟

Aditya Datt के डायरेक्शन में बनी इस एक्शन रोमांस फिल्म में Aparshakti Khurana और Abhishek Singh भी हैं। 🎥

यह फिल्म 27 November 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी। 🍿

क्या आपको इमरान हाशमी और जेनेलिया देशमुख की नई जोड़ी पसंद आई? नीचे कमेंट करके बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Gunmaaster G9: Romantic Track ‘Dard E Dil’ Featuring Emraan Hashmi & Genelia Deshmukh Unveiled!
ctx.summary:
Gunmaaster G9 unveils ‘Dard E Dil’, a romantic track featuring Emraan Hashmi and Genelia Deshmukh, composed and sung by Himesh Reshammiya. 
 The post  Gunmaaster G9: Romantic Track ‘Dard E Dil’ Featuring Emraan Hashmi & Genelia Deshmukh Unveiled!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Gunmaaster G9 has released a new song titled ‘Dard E Dil,’ featuring Emraan Hashmi and Genelia Deshmukh. The romantic track brings a softer side to the action-packed film and showcases the chemistry between its lead pair.
Daed E Dil is a soulful romantic number, adding a beautiful melodic layer to the film’s musical landscape. With Himesh’s signature compositional style and the contrasting textures of his and Akasa’s voices, the song captures the emotional and romantic side of the film’s central pairing.
Composed and sung by Himesh Reshammiya and Akasa Singh, the song has lyrics by Sonia Kapoor Reshammiya. The track adds a romantic angle to the film’s story, which also features action and drama.
Himesh Reshammiya says, “After the blockbuster success of ‘Afsaana Banaaya Aapne’ and ‘Do Do Din Ki Zindagi,’ which have collectively garnered over 300 million views across platforms, including more than 150 million views on my YouTube channel, Himesh Reshammiya Melodies, I am extremely happy to bring you a song that is particularly close to my heart. Its vibrant composition and poetic lyrics, beautifully penned by my wife Sonia, make it very special. ‘Dard E Dil’ is a romantic song with a beautiful melody that stays with you long after you have heard it.”
Director Aditya Datt adds, “This song is extra special to me because its mukhda and hook line have a very personal connection. They remind me of my grandfather, the legendary Anand Bakshi ji, and his iconic song ‘Dard-E-Dil Dard-E-Jigar’ from Karz. While this is an entirely different composition and song, that emotional connection with my grandfather makes it all the more special for me.”
Producer Deepak Mukut says, “A film like Gunmaaster G9 needs music that adds to its overall experience, and ‘Dard E Dil’ brings a beautiful romantic dimension to it. Himesh has created a melody that feels warm and heartfelt, and the song gives Emraan and Genelia’s pairing its own musical high.”
Apart from Emraan Hashmi and Genelia D’Souza, the film also stars Aparshakti Khurana and Abhishek Singh. Directed by Aditya Datt, Gunmaaster G9 is produced by Deepak Mukut , Hunar Mukut, and Sangeeta Ahir under SRE Studio LLP and presented by Soham Rockstar Entertainment Pvt. Ltd.
The action romance is scheduled for worldwide release in theaters on November 27, 2026. PEN Marudhar is handling its all-India distribution, while Phar Films is the overseas distributor.
